acceptedClaim: In the declared linear-inductance prescribed-path model, maintained current supplies both field-energy increase and mechanical work. The 2mN ordinary upward magnetic force reduces a separately supported 1g test-pan indication with g unchanged and survives current reversal.
independentMethod: Complex-step coenergy derivatives with relative target/stator coordinate, exact endpoint work, Simpson sampled-power integration, fixed-flux derivative and contact-domain attack.
limitations: L(z) is a supplied finite-domain model, not a measured coil geometry.
The motion is prescribed; free dynamics, mechanical stage work and a moved load gravitational potential are not solved.
Static one-pan reduction assumes reaction support outside that pan. The independently derived complete static support sum cancels internal force only within the relative-coordinate model.
External fields, leads, heating, buoyancy and dynamic/field momentum remain possible measurement channels outside this model.
Current-even force is not a gravity identifier. No hardware, levitation or gravity change was measured.

sourceChecks.supports: A field-energy-only gradient omits maintained-current source work.
Balance indications include nongravitational interactions; metrology source does not validate this hypothetical coil.
